camera: Standing eye height on the public side near the cab end, just behind the office worker, looking past its shoulder at frame right toward Kasun; medium over-the-shoulder shot, 50mm lens feel.
background: The maroon hatch upright and dark compartment occupy frame left behind Kasun. Pastry trays and the kettle extend across the lower centre; the road, bus-stop pole and broad dark-green tree remain visible through the upper-right opening beyond the blue shoulder.
picture: The blue mannequin’s back and shoulder occupy the right foreground, its chest facing screen left toward the counter and its head tipped toward the cup; its right hand rests on the ledge beside the cup while its left hand hangs at its side. The red mannequin stands behind the ledge left of centre, chest angled screen right toward the cup and head lowered, its right hand gripping the dark-brown handle of the tilted, scuffed silver flask and its left hand resting beside the pastry tray. A thin caramel-brown stream enters the plain cream cup resting on a clear strip of the scratched steel ledge, with a faint steam wisp above it.
